Mohammed Belal is on both BAUS pages; recorded once with both roles, source = the Endourology committee page (listed there as Trustee, and on the trustees page as President-Elect).
BAUS Council, BAUS annual meeting programme and plenary speakers could not be read (council page 404, events page has no annual meeting entry), so no conference speakers recorded.
Lay members of the BAUS trustees (Gareth Collett, Ian Gargan, Ananda Guha) were skipped as not clinical leaders.
British Association of Urological Nurses and European Association of Urology were not used for this speciality.
